hangzhou-2.bio: Chan Buddhist temple at the foot of Feilai Peak, known for its many pagodas and rock-carved grottos.
hangzhou-2.notes: Free entry with advance reservation reported from 1 Dec 2025 (old fee 45 CNY Feilai Peak + 30 CNY incense ticket); news is from Nov 2025, current policy unverified. Official site title 杭州灵隐寺 loaded OK.

hangzhou-40.bio: Large reservoir lake in Lin'an ringed by a 42 km greenway for walking and cycling, with water-sports areas.
hangzhou-40.ticket_note: No single official site found; WeChat-only or none known
hangzhou-40.notes: Greenway is public; free status of the lake itself unverified for 2026 (a 2020 free-opening notice was temporary). Paid water-sports centre is an extra. Pin note: some guides say the scenic-area entrance is across the lake.

mos-manor.bio: Late-Qing Jiangnan gentry mansion in Pinghu, a national protected site with symmetrical halls and a garden.
mos-manor.ticket_note: No official website found; official presence unverified
mos-manor.notes: 28 CNY from a March 2023 travel blog; Ctrip page says paid, price on request. Unverified.

ningbo-3.bio: Ningbo's history museum in Yinzhou, now part of Ningbo Museum Institute, covering the area's history and local customs.
ningbo-3.notes: Free admission reported by 2008 news (free ticket required, daily cap); 2020 report of advance reservation. Official site 宁波博物院 loaded; it says the museum wing closed for works from 16 Mar 2026 with reopening to be announced, so reopening is unverified. Current booking rule unverified.

sanqu-stone-forest.bio: Karst stone forest in Changshan county with limestone pinnacles, caves and a lake, on a walking route.
sanqu-stone-forest.notes: Adult 60 CNY from Qunar (Ctrip from 58); aggregator prices only. Bio detail about caves/lake and walking route not verified from a source; treat bio as unverified, Ctrip says 27.58 km2 4A scenic area.

dongsha-beach.bio: Quieter sandy beach on Zhujiajian island beside Nansha, with free showers reported and calmer crowds.
dongsha-beach.ticket_note: Managed as part of Zhujiajian scenic area; no separate official site found
dongsha-beach.notes: Conflicting prices: Ctrip 35 from, Qunar 2021 review 10 CNY, no charge after 18:00; Zhujiajian page says from 10. Unverified. Bio's 'quieter' and 'free showers' come from reviews/draft, unverified.
